candidate_comparison.routing_note: 0.8375 routing identical to the superseded 0.81 per-sample; 0.75 reclassifies induced-demand (0.80) hub->ring
candidate_comparison.source: counterfactual refit over both gap midpoints (threshold-only difference; card evidence threshold_counterfactual.json — same numbers)
candidate_comparison.verdict: 0.75 better on the headline dims (norm ring AUC/sep/pos_min/LOSO, norm hub AUC/pos_min/LOSO); 0.8375 better on three (hub separation_margin -9.0 vs -9.2, hub negative_scores_max 76.4 vs 77.0, ring negative_scores_max 54.1 vs 56.8; absolute ring neg-max 49.7 vs 50.3) — 0.75 is NOT strictly better on every metric; the choice rests on the headline AUC/LOSO advantage

hub_intensity_threshold_derivation.method: midpoint of the measured empty hub-intensity gap over the threshold-eligible (unlabeled/nested-cycle) population (full corpus, supplemented-edge caliber). HAND-DERIVED, not auto-recomputed: every calibration run logs the per-sample intensity (routing_log "hub_intensity"; the calibration report carries measured_distribution_this_run) and check_hub_intensity_gap() RAISES if a threshold-eligible value lands strictly inside the (0.70, 0.80) gap — fail-loud, never a silent re-route on a stale derivation
hub_intensity_threshold_derivation.reclassify_disclosure: vs the superseded 0.81 snapshot this choice routes induced-demand (measured intensity 0.80) back to hub (ring n_negative 18 -> 17)
hub_intensity_threshold_derivation.rederive_rule: re-measure whenever the corpus grows; gap closure raises via check_hub_intensity_gap() (fail-loud), never tuned around

shape_routing.ring_exclusion_rationale: operator 令：行/列对齐在环族天然低（brand-flywheel 33%），权重必须为 0
shape_routing.rule: ① 族标签：单环→ring，多环耦合/链/星→hub；② 嵌套环与无标签图：先 hub 强度（hub_degree/n ≥ 0.75 → hub；推导式=阈值适用人群中实测空档 [0.70, 0.80] 的中点；实测强度 induced-demand 0.80 / classic-cld 0.875 落在空档上沿，另一空档 [0.80, 0.875] 中点 0.8375 弃选：headline AUC/LOSO 劣于 0.75，但 0.75 在 hub sep、hub/ring neg_max 三项略让步——全维对照见 candidate_comparison，不许选择性省列），再 degree_canvas_spearman（canvas 中心口径，≤0→ring，>0→hub）；③ ρ 退化→全局公式回退。锚点边集在测特征前已按图源补全；jacky 参考值测自仓外副本，仓内数据不可复现（270 组合搜索 0 命中）——路由只依仓内实测值，逐样本记录在 routing_log 待复核
